system.description:
Requirements: You must have been exposed to a corrupting influence

Something dark festers deep in your soul, and you must struggle to prevent it from taking control.

At the start of your turn, if you are Dying, you can forgo the Death Check to give in to your darker impulses.

  • You are no longer Dying.

  • Your Mind, Body, and Soul increase by +1.

  • Your Stamina, Wounds, and Resolve, are fully restored.

  • You seek to destroy whatever creature is nearest to you by the most effective means available to you, though you may prioritize creatures that are an obvious greater threat.

This effect ends after a number of turns equal to your highest attribute, or if you take enough damage to be Dying again.

When this effect ends, you lose all Stamina and Resolve, your Wounds increase to their maximum value, and you are Dying again.

Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until your Wounds have been fully restored.
